text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"My run the other day lacked a proper finish.
It hurts, but I have to honestly admit it."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"That's why in this race—
I will never put on such a pathetic performance again."
choice_data_list: I want you to show me your absolute best run.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll show you.
—A run that surpasses all your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
First place is mine!
This time... I'm not handing it over to anyone!
